title: [Radio’Clock] KOREAPEDIA with GHOST9 #City of Romance Suncheon
description:
점점 더 더워지는 날씨에 여름 휴가가 절실해지는데요!
철새들이 날아드는 순천만과 아름답게 꾸며진 정원
고즈넉한 풍경이 함께하는 평화로운 느낌의 사찰

As the weather gets hotter, summer vacation is desperately needed!
Suncheonman with migrating birds flying in and beautifully adorned gardens,
a tranquil temple with serene landscapes,
it's a place where delicious food and scenery come together.
How about planning a summer vacation in Suncheon?
